promotionNotice: This handoff does not promote Gate A/B/C, Phase 3, or Release status.

targetScope.description: Create a card or token and immediately put it into active state, only if an exact canonical source representative exists.

baselineForB.instruction: Use the accepted post-P3-B08 checkout as the numeric before baseline. Regenerate phase3:coverage in B09 before reporting before/after.

requiredFirstStep: Produce source-authoring inventory for explicit create_and_activate_card primitives.
Check create_card immediately followed by activation or active-zone placement.
Check create_card effects whose canonical printed text says the created card is immediately active.
Include historically suspected cards such as Drake only as candidates until source JSON and rules justify the contract.
stopConditions: NO_ELIGIBLE_REPRESENTATIVE if no exact representative exists in canonical source authoring.
RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_GAP if canonical rules require create-and-activate but source authoring cannot express it.
Do not patch roster JSON, invent an ability-id route, or migrate Drake under this contract just to keep the sequence moving.
exactContractRequirementsIfEligible: source zone and destination or activation zone
whether creation is once-per-game, per-window, or repeatable
stale command or stale event rejection
typed result fields for both creation and activation
gateCInvalidatedBy: activating an already-existing card without creation
standalone create_card that only places a card in skill/deck/hand
hidden/private target selection not covered by the exact representative
bChecklist: Prove whether an exact representative exists before changing runtime.
If no exact representative exists, stop with NO_ELIGIBLE_REPRESENTATIVE or RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_GAP.
If an exact representative exists, prove routing by semantic form, not ability id.

Prove compiler fail-closed for missing created definition, invalid destination, invalid visibility, missing activation state, duplicate ambiguous identity, extra effects, wrong timing, and unsupported cleanup.
Prove runtime rollback if create succeeds but activation fails.
Prove stale replay does not duplicate created card, activation state, event log, or projection state.
Prove browser/server evidence covers source command or event, WS expectedRevision where command-driven, server revalidation, projection, reconnect, and stale rejection.
Keep Drake mount-summon under play_selected_cards unless canonical source proves otherwise.
Report before/after legacy route counts against the accepted post-P3-B08 baseline.
